typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ROOT_CLCL_ID as string,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE as string,
		SC_SCHEME as string,
		SC_SUBSCHEME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT  	CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SUBSTRING(C.sourceClaimId, 1, 10)) AS ROOT_CLCL_ID, 	CONVERT(VARCHAR(200), C.leadType) AS CCERT_LEAD_TYPE, 	CONVERT(VARCHAR(25), C.scheme) AS SC_SCHEME, 	CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), C.subscheme) AS SC_SUBSCHEME FROM BidorCase.vwDrgCase C WHERE C.caseStatusConfigId IN (40, 2402) /*40=open,2402=complete*/',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		ROOT_CLCL_ID as string,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE as string,
		SC_SCHEME as string,
		SC_SUBSCHEME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		ROOT_CLCL_ID,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE,
		SC_SCHEME,
		SC_SUBSCHEME)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOracleDestination
